# Practical playbooks

These task-based guides are runnable starting points. Test them in a disposable environment, review credentials and external writes, and adapt commands to the versions in use.

## Foundation

- [Install OpenClaw and complete a first safe run](install-and-first-run.md) - Move from a clean host to a minimally configured assistant while keeping pairing and tool access constrained. (beginner; tested)

## Operations

- [Configure one messaging channel safely](configure-a-channel-safely.md) - Add one channel with constrained credentials and prove delivery without exposing the Gateway broadly. (intermediate; tested)

## Skills and automation

- [Audit a skill before installing it](audit-a-skill-before-install.md) - Inspect a skill's provenance permissions and behavior before allowing it into an OpenClaw workspace. (intermediate; tested)

## Deployment

- [Deploy OpenClaw with Docker and sandboxing](deploy-with-docker-and-sandboxing.md) - Create a reproducible container deployment with explicit mounts networking and tool-execution boundaries. (advanced; tested)

## Security and recovery

- [Recover a compromised or misconfigured Gateway](recover-and-rotate-credentials.md) - Contain a suspicious Gateway state and rotate exposed credentials before restoring only reviewed configuration. (advanced; tested)

Playbook records are generated into [data/playbook.csv](../../data/playbook.csv).
